title: GeomPrototypeAPI
summary: Native-instancing tag that ovstage population writes on native-instancing prototype prims. The parser reads no column for it; prototype prims provide the geometry and attributes that instance proxies resolve to.
producer_scope: Written by ovstage population; no USD schema applies it.
notes: No USD schema applies this name and it declares no column; the parser keys native instancing on the ovstage instancing queries (instance and prototype roots), not on attributes.
